description: Structured desired states used by PWB to translate user goals and assessment signals into relevant body systems and mechanisms. Outcomes are not diagnoses and do not themselves represent treatment claims.
designPrinciples: Goals represent what the user wants to improve; outcomes represent the structured PWB target.
An outcome can receive signals from direct questionnaire answers, body-system scores, demographics and lifestyle goals.
Outcomes should not directly recommend foods or products. They connect the user profile to the existing mechanism taxonomy.
Demographic information modifies relevance and evidence applicability; it should not independently create a physiological need.
Direct questionnaire signals can supplement the nine body-system scores rather than being discarded after score calculation.
Outcome mappings should be evidence-graded and should not imply causality where the source evidence is only associative.

proposedScoringInputs.quizSystemNeed: Derived from the existing doctor-designed questionnaire and nine body-system scores.
proposedScoringInputs.directQuestionSignals: Selected questionnaire answers that have an explicit or particularly strong relationship to an outcome.
proposedScoringInputs.goalIntent: One to three goals selected by the user.
proposedScoringInputs.demographicContext: Age range and gender used as modifiers, including conditional menopause questions.
proposedScoringInputs.weighting: Not fixed in this version. Test cases should be used before production weights are chosen.
